reviews.text:
Delighted with this grooming. My little Vanille has been getting groomed regularly for a few months now. I'd tried several groomers before, but they didn't live up to my expectations because I wasn't convinced by their services. I highly recommend pawfection for their professionalism, the friendliness of the staff, and the cleanliness of the place. Beyond the very organized system with its "client-dog" follow-up, the results of the services are exactly what I hoped for. The price isn't any more excessive than elsewhere for a much more polished result! I'm thrilled! And thank you for the attention you give to my little dog.

Carole
Very satisfied. The gentleman is very friendly, a true professional. The plucking and scissor cut were done perfectly; we've officially found Naya's groomer. The salon was very clean.
Very happy with the grooming done on my dog, very good and very pleasant team, I recommend them.
Merci

Very nice haircut, well done. Friendly welcome, I'll be back for my border collie.

Thank you very much.

I am so happy with the care our Précieuse received. Unfortunately, she had a lot of knots and mats of fur stuck all over her body and had to be completely shaved. Despite the challenging nature of the situation, this couple demonstrated remarkable professionalism, incredible patience, gentleness, and great kindness.

They took all the time necessary, never rushing her, respecting her pace and constantly reassuring her. They even managed to calm Précieuse, who is usually very wild and wary and doesn't trust easily!

You can immediately feel their experience, their love, and above all, their deep respect for animals. Exceptional care, as professional as it is compassionate. I would entrust my cats to them again without hesitation. A truly wonderful experience and a place we wholeheartedly recommend! ❤️
I've been going to Pawfection for over a year now for my Pomeranian and I can only recommend it 100%!

Excellent service.
My young standard poodle received a fantastic grooming session.
Nice workspace.
I've already booked two more appointments 😊👌
Merci
The gentleman is super nice, I highly recommend him

We are very happy with this salon!
Perla looks magnificent!
Well done!
Merci

I don't regret coming to Pawfection! First visit and definitely not the last. My dog ​​is incredibly difficult to groom, and they managed to give him a royal cut. The welcome was very pleasant.
I can't wait for Simba's next grooming appointment.

First visit for a cat.
She was brushed, her eyes and ears were cleaned, and her nails were trimmed.
No complaints, excellent service and very helpful advice.
Very professional.
I recommend them 100%.

Excellent experience! Everything was done to make my senior cat comfortable and relaxed: with great gentleness and professionalism. He had quite a few knots to remove… the groomer took the time to analyze the situation, explain everything, and most importantly, he took the time to introduce the "horrible" clippers to the kitten so she wouldn't be afraid. All the steps were explained, advice was given, and the entire staff was very friendly. I highly recommend them! Thank you again for Liu!

I'm so happy with Lebron's first grooming session. He listened carefully, gave great advice, and took his time and was very patient with my dog, who isn't easy (a Shiba Inu) and is extremely anxious!

Finally, a conscientious groomer who trims nails, cleans ears, combs the hair, and perfumes... I highly recommend him. In fact, I've already booked an appointment for my second dog next week.
Thank you again for your professionalism!

First visit for a cat.
She was brushed, her eyes and ears were cleaned, and her nails were trimmed.
Nothing to complain about, excellent service and very good advice.
Very professional.
I recommend 100%.
Perle

Hello,

Just a quick note to thank you for our wonderful Lucky, who is now walking very well! We found the brush you showed us, and it's perfect for his coat!

A huge thank you to you and your team for your kindness, gentleness, and love of animals!

Go to PAWFECTION, you won't regret it!

Everything was perfect. My cat, on his first visit to a groomer, was very stressed but handled with great gentleness. The result is impeccable; he looks beautiful. You can feel the passion and love for animals. I highly recommend them. Thank you so much! 😺 …

First time taking my dog ​​to Pawfection, and it certainly won't be the last!

The groomer took excellent care of him. He was reassuring, very attentive, and incredibly patient with Olaf. I picked him up looking fantastic after his grooming, and I'm thrilled with the result.

I highly recommend them. Thank you again for your kindness, patience, and professionalism!

Perfect grooming and a cool salon despite the heatwave outside.
I highly recommend it.
Excellent work, warm welcome, and perfect results. I highly recommend them.
A very competent person, knows their job very well, and provides us with excellent information. A very pleasant and friendly person, excellent work! Well done!
Excellent grooming center, attentive and Nooky happy
Excellent service. We got our Australian Shepherd (Ludo) back exactly as we wanted. I highly recommend them!

A very satisfying first experience. Very attentive and excellent service for our Yorkshire Terrier.

I highly recommend them.
Excellent groomer. Attentive and offers great advice. I highly recommend him 👍 …

All our cats are groomed at Pawfection.
They are very patient with cats, take their needs into account, and are quick and efficient!
I highly recommend them!

Very professional
Very friendly
A very successful first experience
A very pleasant surprise

I went because there were good reviews about this groomer, and I certainly don't regret it.
My Spitz came out looking very handsome, well-groomed, with a perfect cut, smelling wonderful, and happy.
The groomer is very friendly and gentle with animals; you can tell he loves his job.

Back at Pawfection!
The groomer was very efficient and professional, as usual. He took great care of my cats and knew how to put them at ease. Meticulous and high-quality work; I highly recommend him!
See you soon!
I'm so happy, the welcome was great and they took such good care of the dog who came out looking beautiful

I've taken my dog ​​Peanuts several times and I'm always so happy!
She's naturally very anxious, but everything goes wonderfully every time.
She comes out looking beautiful 🐶✨
I highly recommend it ❤️ …

Fantastic!!! We were lucky enough to meet a dog lover, a true professional, passionate about his work. Our springer came out perfectly groomed for the summer (we live in an area where stray dogs are a real problem) while respecting the breed standards.
A fantastic groomer, go there without hesitation!

I took my little Chihuahua in!

And I'm so happy with the result!!
A fantastic salon; you can tell they truly love their work.
Gentle and professional.
And thank you, Mélanie!! Luna is absolutely gorgeous.
A fabulous welcome, very kind and professional staff. And the dog is beautiful! This is the third groomer I've tried in Marseille, I won't be going anywhere else! Thank you.

What a surprise! It was the first time I'd taken my dog ​​to a groomer, and I was so surprised I hardly recognized them. The work was exquisite, the service was fantastic, I'll definitely be back without hesitation; in fact, I've already planned to take my second dog there.
A very friendly and professional welcome. My French bulldog had a wonderful rapport and didn't want to leave at all. I highly recommend them.

I'd like to thank the gentleman and lady who gave my little dachshund a complete bath! My dog ​​came out sparkling clean and beautiful! She smelled wonderful! So proud! 😀 I've brought her back several times for nail trims too, and the results are always perfect! Thank you, sir, for being so gentle and kind with our little companions!

I highly recommend this grooming salon.
Perfect for a very timid little Chihuahua, and absolutely gorgeous! You can go there with your eyes closed, and the price is more than reasonable.
I took my cat Gaspard to have his knots trimmed. Everything went very well, the groomer was very gentle with my cat, I highly recommend him!

I found a very professional and extremely kind groomer. He pampered my little Yorkie perfectly. His love for animals is evident.

Thank you.

Incredible experience!! Thank you for your gentleness, efficiency, and kindness.

I was very apprehensive about this first visit for my very timid cat, but everything went perfectly.
I highly recommend them! If you're looking for a groomer, go for it!

I had my English Setter groomed today for the second time, and I'm absolutely delighted with the work done.

I highly recommend this grooming salon, both for the owner's kindness and the quality of service.

Pawfection is easy to find, and there's even parking. The shop itself isn't much to look at, but the owner is fantastic! 👌🏻 He managed to give our cat, who isn't always easy to handle, a perfect grooming session with a smile. It's truly a pleasure to meet such professional yet friendly people. I'm also very happy to say the same about his assistant. I highly recommend him.

Thank you! 👍🏻😉
I'm very satisfied with my cat's grooming. The work was meticulous, with a lot of gentleness and patience. My cat was calm and the result is impeccable. I highly recommend them!
I love it! They're ultra-professional, my two little pups are gorgeous! 🥰 …

A perfect experience for my Spitz! The salon is spotless and the welcome very warm. You can immediately tell that "Mr. PAWFECTION" loves animals and has real expertise. My Spitz left relaxed, with a beautiful, perfectly groomed coat. A big thank you for your professionalism! See you soon…

Very satisfied with the grooming of my 13-year-old dog.

Don't hesitate any longer. Call to make an appointment.
